generic_range.source: Explicit inclusive integer range used when a venue year has no registered discrete scale. Integers inside the range are kept. Integers outside it are unparsed and counted.

iclr2024.source: Kargaran et al., arXiv:2511.15462: the ICLR 2024 overall rating is a discrete number in {1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10}.

iclr2025.source: Kargaran et al., arXiv:2511.15462: the ICLR 2025 overall rating uses the same discrete set as ICLR 2024.

iclr2026.source: Kargaran et al., arXiv:2511.15462 footnote: the ICLR 2026 overall rating is mapped to {0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10}. The ICLR 2026 reviewer guide page does not list these integers.
